user.title: Set up Wunderground PWS
user.description: Enter the Weather Underground station ID (e.g. IKAPOS27). The API key is optional: if you leave it empty, the integration tries to obtain one automatically (demo mode). Entering a forecast city shows a 7-day forecast on the weather card.

discover.title: Confirm the API key
discover.description:
Automatic API key discovery for station {station_id}: **{discovery_status}**.

Check the key below, or enter your own key if the discovery did not work.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Wunderground PWS
reauth_confirm.description: The API key of station {station_id} no longer works. Enter a new key, or leave the field empty to try the automatic discovery again.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Weather Underground API. Please try again later.
error.invalid_auth: The API key was rejected by Weather Underground.
error.unknown_station: The station was not found or has not reported recent data. Check the station ID.
error.api_key_required: The API key cannot be empty.
error.discovery_failed: The automatic API key discovery did not find a key. Enter one manually.

init.title: Wunderground PWS options (station {station_id})
init.description:
Clearing the API key field starts the automatic key discovery. The station ID cannot be changed - add a new entry for another station.

Forecast source **auto** tries Weather Underground, then MET Norway, then Open-Meteo.
